blocks.text: write_message logs "Task exception was never retrieved" when the connection closes
当 websocket 连接在仍有消息未发送时关闭（例如，客户端发送了消息和一个 FIN，或重置了连接，却没有读取回复），每一个结果未被 await 的 write_message() 调用都会在 ERROR 级别记录“Task exception was never retrieved”。
await write_message 返回的 Future 是可选的，因此未 await 的调用不应记录任何内容。而确实 await 它的调用方仍应收到 WebSocketClosedError。

inlines.text: The bug is in Tornado's websocket code. When a connection closed with messages still unsent, every
write_message()
call that wasn't awaited logged an error, even though awaiting it is optional. We sent every text file in that checkout as one prompt, with a bug report that describes only the symptom:

blocks.text: write_message logs "Task exception was never retrieved" when the connection closes

When a websocket connection closes while messages are still unsent (for example, the client sends its messages and a FIN, or resets the connection, without reading the replies), every write_message() call whose result was not awaited logs "Task exception was never retrieved" at ERROR level.
Awaiting the Future returned by write_message is optional, so an unawaited call should not log anything. A caller that does await it should still get WebSocketClosedError.

blocks.text: About Qwen4 Max

inlines.text: About Qwen4 Max

blocks.text: Alibaba released Qwen4 Max on November 16, 2026, and describes it as the most capable model in the Qwen family to date. It positions the model for long agent work, including coding across large repositories, which is the kind of task we tested.

inlines.text: Alibaba released Qwen4 Max on November 16, 2026, and describes it as the most capable model in the Qwen family to date. It positions the model for long agent work, including coding across large repositories, which is the kind of task we tested.

blocks.text: Qwen4 Max is a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 2.4 trillion parameters, of which 71 billion are active for each token. On Work360, Alibaba's own benchmark of industry tasks across 721 specialized fields, Alibaba reports that it outperforms Qwen3.8 Max overall, uses 35% fewer tokens at high reasoning effort, and costs about 60% less per task on average. Those are Alibaba's figures, and its announcement has the details.

blocks.text: Why does my Qwen4 Max request fail without streaming?

inlines.text: Why does my Qwen4 Max request fail without streaming?

blocks.text: Qwen4 Max on Together AI accepts streaming requests only. A request without "stream": true returns a 400 error with the code streaming_required. Set stream=True in the SDK, or "stream": true in the request body, and read the reply from the stream.

blocks.text: How do I turn off thinking on Qwen4 Max?

inlines.text: How do I turn off thinking on Qwen4 Max?

blocks.text: Pass reasoning={"enabled": False} in the Python SDK, or "reasoning": {"enabled": false} in the request body, to turn off thinking on Qwen4 Max. Thinking is on by default, and it comes back in the reasoning field ahead of the answer. To get more thinking on a hard problem, set reasoning_effort to "max".
